goal: Stop libbitcoinkernel from treating invalid blocks as valid under different parameters
Ensure subsequent block checks re-verify consensus rules instead of reusing cached results
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections (yuvicc)
Notes that the minimal overhead of re-running context-free checks is acceptable (yuvicc)
Author addressed requests to add documentation and test assertion checks (yuvicc)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it fixes a consensus correctness flaw in libbitcoinkernel
Blocks verified under one set of rules can no longer falsely pass under stricter parameters
Protects external applications relying on kernel API consensus guarantees
